issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

**Budget.** budget.total_seconds 36000 (10 h) for this world: about 8.5 h for the 2 × 15 diagnostic and 2 × 15 held-out runs, the calibration drafts, their judging, the put-back and the 4 × 5 final-test runs, plus one provider stall of about an hour; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

**Budget.** budget.total_seconds 36000 (10 h) for this world: about 8.5 h for the 2 × 15 diagnostic and 2 × 15 held-out runs, the calibration drafts, their judging, the put-back and the 4 × 5 final-test runs, plus one provider stall of about an hour; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

**Budget.** budget.total_seconds 36000 (10 h) for this world: about 8.5 h for the 2 × 15 diagnostic and 2 × 15 held-out runs, the calibration drafts, their judging, the put-back and the 4 × 5 final-test runs, plus one provider stall of about an hour; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

**Budget.** budget.total_seconds 36000 (10 h) for this world: about 8.5 h for the 2 × 15 diagnostic and 2 × 15 held-out runs, the calibration drafts, their judging, the put-back and the 4 × 5 final-test runs, plus one provider stall of about an hour; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round N3 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and
internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code
claude-sonnet-5-5. Only the workers change: their prompt, assets, skills, the agent's own settings, effort and
max_context_fraction. The positions' function text, contracts and everything else of rw_313df9cf84a4 stay as they are.

**Incumbent.** cand-g2: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at
1e2f008 (dw_1475d43aee7b, kept through dw_a42fcf98e9a5).

**What to improve first.** On paper_35, cand-g2 scored higher than incumbent@v3 by writing longer and citing more, while
it lost on content: page budget +2.6 (PDFs of 11–13 pages against 6–7), citations +1.6, faithfulness −0.8, hedging
−1.0, prose −0.6. These are rubric v2 means over 5 runs each, in dw_a42fcf98e9a5's evaluation record 3f01e46 [C1, C3].
This round improves what the paper says without giving those back:

- claims that the writing material supports, and no others;
- claims stated with the strength the evidence allows;
- figures and tables read as they are;
- citations placed where they support a claim, not added to raise coverage.

Also check whether internal-review-repo still approves a draft at once. That was seen only in the first round
(dw_59f01b2fe95e problems.md B) [C2]. If it does, make it find what the content items find.

**Tasks.** Each task is one paper, written in a world continued from that paper's world at c0. It uses that world's
full configuration with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []` written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256). Material and
  isolation are as in dw_1475d43aee7b.
- Final test: paper_38 (CVPR 2026), which no round has read. Its world is rw_999511721bf2 at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-357-test, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource; both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do. After the decision, incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo, cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), cand-g2 and the kept worker, if it is not cand-g2, run 5 times each on it with the task settings above and are judged by the judging below, blind and together; this compares the line's workers under one judge line and decides nothing.

**Judging: the same on diagnostic and held-out results** [B2, B3, A2]

- **Rubric v2** (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee…f1250) on every manuscript, diagnostic ones
  included. On diagnostic runs the diagnostician reads each manuscript against it, citing lines. The diagnosis says
  which content faults a candidate is to remove.
- **Reporting.** Always report the content items separately: faithfulness, hedging, figure/table interpretation,
  argument and prose. Report them apart from the form items (page budget, template, required sections) and from
  citation fit.
- **The verifier** (evaluate.py) is reported for every manuscript with every component. It measures citation coverage
  almost alone: reward ≈ const + 0.25 × coverage. So it is a sanity floor (format_valid = 1, sections = 1), not a
  signal of writing quality, and no decision rests on its mean [B3].
- **Calibration** [B4]. Before scoring, the judge scores one known-worse draft per held-out paper. The task-setter makes
  it from a held-out manuscript by inserting three unsupported claims and one misread figure. Its content items must
  come out lower. If they do not, the judging is fixed before any comparison.
- **One judge line throughout** [B4, B7]: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, with no fallback: when the line answers overload, the world waits until it answers again. A
  change of line restarts the comparison's judging.

**Comparison and rule** [B1]

- Run each worker 5 times per held-out paper. Compare by paper-paired differences of the rubric total and of the
  content-item sum.
- A candidate is kept only if both of these hold:
  - its total is higher, with the difference larger than twice its standard error (paired over runs and papers);
  - its content-item sum is not lower by more than one standard error.
- Report the means, standard errors, t and the per-item differences. Also report the old range rule's result, for
  comparison only.

**Candidates** [B5]. The tuner may offer up to two candidates. A candidate may use any worker surface listed above. Each
candidate says which diagnosed content fault it targets and shows, on the diagnostic tasks, the rubric items that moved.

**Who reads what** [B6]. The diagnostician receives the judge summaries of round N2 and of the final test T after it (dw_1475d43aee7b and dw_a42fcf98e9a5, in the previous-round resource) through the coach. It is not a
neighbour of the judge.

**Put-back** [A3]. Put the kept worker back at a checkpoint of rw_313df9cf84a4 where paper-repo or internal-review-repo
owe work, not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`, whose manuscript is already delivered. The round counts as run only if its
records show the kept worker producing new output.

**Images** [B8]. Every run sets worker.image to sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd (researchworld-worker:i357), and worker.environment_image to sha256:893eb3b5f3203593b58be1a68016335198fcc4426ddf3639bf071a6364f7fb8e for paper_29 and sha256:47e4c66fa1b58debcfe062150501d3cf759cd6e277afdd0af22110ab738f7b2b for paper_39, whose recorded environment images are no longer on the host and were rebuilt from the same task files; the other papers keep their recorded environment images.

**Budget.** budget.total_seconds 36000 (10 h) for this world: about 8.5 h for the 2 × 15 diagnostic and 2 × 15 held-out runs, the calibration drafts, their judging, the put-back and the 4 × 5 final-test runs, plus one provider stall of about an hour; have the release done well before it.
